tutorial_instructions.en: Change length or cross divisions; compare complex port constraints and power. The basis is longitudinal.
tutorial_instructions.zh-CN: 修改长度或横向离散，核对复端口约束与功率。基函数沿纵向。

fixed_conventions: SI; exp(+j omega t); RMS; sigma=58 MS/m; mu_r=1; 20 C

en: Discretize the cross section into longitudinal current basis elements. Galerkin projection of the magnetoquasistatic integral equation gives Z=R+jωL, where R follows from conductivity and basis overlap and L contains finite-length mutual and self interactions.
Solve Zi=V1 and 1ᵀi=It simultaneously. The terminal voltage and complex currents are unknowns. Real input power must equal the quadratic resistive loss iᴴRi.

Vary cross-section divisions, longitudinal length and quadrature independently. This longitudinal basis omits general transverse current and end-region charge; it must not be presented as a full vector 3D conductor solution.
zh-CN: 将截面离散为纵向电流基函数。磁准静态积分方程经 Galerkin 投影得到 Z=R+jωL；R 由电导率与基函数重叠构造，L 含有限长度互项与自项。
联立 Zi=V1、1ᵀi=It 求未知端电压与复电流。有功输入须与电阻二次型损耗 iᴴRi 一致。
横向离散、轴向长度和积分阶数分别研究。纵向基函数未保留一般横向电流及完整端区电荷，适用范围应据此解释。
